import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter

def f(g):
    a=np.array(g); h,w=a.shape
    cnt=Counter(a.ravel()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mk=None; kind=None
    fullrow=sum(int((a[r,:]==2).sum()==w) for r in range(h))
    fullcol=sum(int((a[:,c]==2).sum()==h) for c in range(w))
    if fullrow==1: kind='row'; mk=next(r for r in range(h) if (a[r,:]==2).sum()==w)
    elif fullcol==1: kind='col'; mk=next(c for c in range(w) if (a[:,c]==2).sum()==h)
    res=np.full_like(a,bg)
    L=w//2+1 if kind=='col' else h//2+1
    if kind=='col':
        res[:,mk]=2; res[:,L]=8
        cells=[(y,x,int(a[y,x])) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if a[y,x]!=bg and a[y,x]!=2]
        xs=[c for _,c,_ in cells]; mn=min(xs); mx=max(xs)
        T=(mk-1)-mx if mx<mk else (mk-1)-mn
        for y,x,v in cells: res[y,x+T]=v
    else:
        res[mk,:]=2; res[L,:]=8
        cells=[(y,x,int(a[y,x])) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if a[y,x]!=bg and a[y,x]!=2]
        ys=[r for r,_,_ in cells]; mn=min(ys); mx=max(ys)
        T=(mk-1)-mx if mx<mk else (mk-1)-mn
        for y,x,v in cells: res[y+T,x]=v
    return res.tolist()
